task: 50 verified reload/configuration/resource SVG candidates for Axiom2 native pi reload entry

recommendation.reason_zh: 齿轮明确表达配置，环形箭头表达重新加载。C01优先，C02偏同步语义。产品入口待用户选择。

rendering.note: MDI使用填充路径形成轮廓，保留原始路径，不对其额外描边。

verification.method: Python urllib GET every raw_svg_url; require HTTP 200 and XML SVG root; save exact bytes and SHA-256. Fetch official LICENSE texts.
limitations: Individual website detail pages were not all fetched; Tabler/Iconoir website probes returned 403. Official repository SVG downloads and LICENSE downloads succeeded.
Iconoir website_url is the official catalog homepage; source_page_url is the exact individual official repository SVG page. No guessed Iconoir detail routes.
iconify_catalog_url is a supplementary browsing link; sample requests returned 403 and these pages are not verified.
main branch download URLs may change later; saved bytes and SHA-256 record this research snapshot.
No application behavior, browser rendering, or native pi reload flow was tested.

licenses.notice: 保留版权与许可文本。Lucide 完整 LICENSE 另列部分 Feather 衍生图标的 MIT 条款；本次候选不在该列表中。
官方图标许可声明，保留版权及许可。
